question: GQ-009
subject: decision coverage 4 of 6 -> 5 of 6, and why the sixth stays out
the_gap: audit-decisions covered 4 of 6, and the two it missed were exactly the two that had gone stale

decision_7_added.design_note: >= not ==. Ingesting MORE books does not falsify "179 were ingested", and an equality check would make this decision contradict itself on the very next ingest — a gate that breaks on success.

decision_6_deliberately_excluded.why_excluded: a sliding value cannot satisfy an equality check. It fails on every run and trains the reader to ignore the gate — the same reason routing.requests and free_pages are undeclared.
decision_6_deliberately_excluded.what_it_carries_instead: a before/after table, which is honest about being a snapshot
decision_6_deliberately_excluded.stated_in_the_file: so the exclusion is a decision, not an oversight
